name: Peninsula meta-node region
note: Developer-proposed. A tight subregion among Palmer City, Pergamino, Marambio, Esperanza and Puerto Abrigo (centroid shown). A Weddell-facing array on the southeast side (Rothera or Marambio) trims 80 to 220 km to the Weddell sector.

name: Mawson
note: Developer-proposed. Research: helpful, not required (Utstein to Casey, 3,198 km, works 22 to 24 h at 1 kW with +6 dBi).

name: Halley
note: Weddell sector. A Weddell node is REQUIRED for simple antennas (the 3,288 km hop fails 3 to 21 h/day at 0 dBi), HELPFUL with 1 kW and +6 dBi. Hops 1,777 / 1,551 km. Halley is on a moving ice shelf (about 1,400 m/yr): site antennas on stable ground.

name: Belgrano
note: Weddell sector alternative to Halley. Hops 1,766 / 1,713 km. Farther poleward (-70 deg geomagnetic).

name: Neumayer
note: Weddell sector. Research: adds a failure point and no improvement once Belgrano or Halley is in.

name: Mirny
note: Splits Mawson to Casey (1,297 / 778 km). Research: direct Mawson to Casey is already 24 h at 1 kW +6 dBi, so this only shortens hops.

name: Davis / Larsemann Hills
note: Prydz Bay site (Davis, Zhongshan, Sinheung and Shirayuki are within about 110 km: one shared node is enough).

name: Signy
note: Regional hub for the Scotia Sea (838 km from the Peninsula). Not a link in the trunk: it is 1,811 to 1,987 km from the Weddell nodes.

name: Rothera
note: Weddell-facing Peninsula antenna site and the best anchor for a Byrd link (one quiet end, -58 deg geomagnetic).

name: Byrd
note: Byrd to Rothera 1,990 km feasible at 1 kW with +6 dBi; Byrd to Belgrano 1,663 km weaker (polar night at solar minimum).

name: Macquarie Island
note: Australian station (Tasmanian territory), 1,544 km from Hobart. Mid-latitude site (about -59 deg geomagnetic, sub-auroral). Would split Hobart to Dumont d'Urville (2,681 km direct) into 1,544 + 1,688 km and bring the Ross Sea cities to 1,944 (Cape Adare) to 2,614 km (Fort McMurdo); Casey 2,868 km. Radio model pending; not known to exist in canon.

name: Hobart
note: Real-world gateway city shown for reference only (Antarctic gateway of the Australian program). Not a Tepenian city.

name: Dumont d'Urville
note: City, shown as a link endpoint.
